title: Atoning for Unsolved Murder

questions.question: If a slain man is found in the field and the murderer is unknown, who must measure the distance to the cities?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:2 (ESV): "then your elders and your judges shall come out and they shall measure the distance..."

questions.question: What animal is used in the ritual for unsolved murder?
options: A heifer that has never been worked
questions.correctAnswer: A heifer that has never been worked
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:3 (ESV): "...the elders of the city... shall take a heifer that has never been worked..."

questions.question: What is done to the heifer?
options: Its neck is broken in a valley with running water
questions.correctAnswer: Its neck is broken in a valley with running water
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:4 (ESV): "...and shall break the heifer's neck there in the valley."

questions.question: If a man sees a captive woman and desires her, what must he do before marrying her?
options: Bring her home, shave her head, pare her nails, and let her mourn for a month
questions.correctAnswer: Bring her home, shave her head, pare her nails, and let her mourn for a month
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:12–13 (ESV): "then you shall bring her home to your house, and she shall shave her head and pare her nails... and bewail her father and her mother a full month..."

questions.question: Which son gets the double portion inheritance?
options: The firstborn, even if he is the son of the disliked wife
The son of the loved wife
questions.correctAnswer: The firstborn, even if he is the son of the disliked wife
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:15–17 (ESV): "...he may not treat the son of the loved as the firstborn in preference to the son of the disliked... but he shall acknowledge the firstborn..."

questions.question: What is done to a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey?
options: The men of the city stone him to death
questions.correctAnswer: The men of the city stone him to death
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:21 (ESV): "Then all the men of the city shall stone him to death with stones."

questions.question: How long can a body hang on a tree?
options: You shall not let his corpse remain all night; bury him the same day
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not let his corpse remain all night; bury him the same day
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:23 (ESV): "his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall bury him the same day..."

questions.question: Why must the hanging body be buried the same day?
options: For a hanged man is cursed by God; you shall not defile your land
questions.correctAnswer: For a hanged man is cursed by God; you shall not defile your land
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:23 (ESV): "...for a hanged man is cursed by God. You shall not defile your land..."

questions.question: Who washes their hands over the heifer?
options: All the elders of that city nearest to the slain man
questions.correctAnswer: All the elders of that city nearest to the slain man
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:6 (ESV): "And all the elders of that city nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer..."

questions.question: What do the elders say while washing hands?
options: "Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it shed."
questions.correctAnswer: "Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it shed."
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:7 (ESV): "Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it shed."

questions.question: If after marrying the captive woman he has no delight in her, what must he do?
options: Let her go wherever she wants, but not sell her for money
questions.correctAnswer: Let her go wherever she wants, but not sell her for money
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:14 (ESV): "...then you shall let her go wherever she wants. But you shall not sell her for money..."

questions.question: Why can he not treat her as a slave?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:14 (ESV): "you shall not treat her as a slave, since you have humiliated her."

questions.question: The stubborn son is described as not obeying the voice of his father and mother, and what else?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:20 (ESV): "...He is a glutton and a drunkard."

questions.question: Why is the firstborn right maintained despite dislike for the mother?
options: For he is the firstfruits of his strength; the right of the firstborn is his
questions.correctAnswer: For he is the firstfruits of his strength; the right of the firstborn is his
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:17 (ESV): "...for he is the firstfruits of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his."

questions.question: What is asked of God regarding the blood of the innocent?
options: "Do not place the guilt of innocent blood in the midst of your people"
questions.correctAnswer: "Do not place the guilt of innocent blood in the midst of your people"
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 21:8 (ESV): "...And do not place the guilt of innocent blood in the midst of your people Israel..."

key_verse_text: ...his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall bury him the same day, for a hanged man is cursed by God. (ESV)
